name: 48188 · Canton, MI
findings: ZIP 48188 (Canton) has 110 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48188 (Canton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48188 (Canton) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).
